title: Import Apify dataset leads into HubSpot contacts

hubspotAccessToken.title: HubSpot access token
hubspotAccessToken.description: Your HubSpot access token. Works with both private app tokens (from Settings > Integrations > Private Apps) and OAuth access tokens.

datasetId.title: Dataset
datasetId.description: Apify dataset containing leadsEnrichment[] rows per company.

importMode.title: Import mode
importMode.description: Only 'contacts' is supported. Each dataset item's leadsEnrichment[] rows are imported as HubSpot contacts.

runId.title: Backend run ID
runId.description: Run identifier used to correlate per-company callback reports with the backend's run record.

runSecret.title: Run secret
runSecret.description: Shared secret passed with each callback POST for authentication.

callbackUrl.title: Callback URL
callbackUrl.description: Backend URL receiving per-company stats via POST.

companyUrlMapping.title: Company URL to HubSpot ID mapping
companyUrlMapping.description: Map company URLs to their HubSpot company IDs. Dataset items are matched via the 'originalStartUrl' field and leads are associated to the matched company.

companyId.title: HubSpot company ID
companyId.description: The HubSpot company ID that matched leads should be associated with.

dataMappings.title: Field mappings
dataMappings.description: Map leadsEnrichment fields to HubSpot contact properties. 'source' must be a leadsEnrichment field name (e.g. 'email', 'firstName'); 'target' is the internal HubSpot contact property name (e.g. 'email', 'firstname').

target.title: HubSpot property
target.description: Internal name of an existing HubSpot contact property (e.g. 'email', 'firstname').
